description: Canonical signature algorithm vocabulary and explicit per-standard mappings for v1 JOSE, Arkret raw signatures, and RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures.
registry_rules: A JWS protected header MUST use the standard JOSE member alg and its value MUST equal the active row's jose_algorithm. Arkret MUST NOT rename members inside a JOSE object.
An Arkret-owned raw-signature carrier MUST use signature_algorithm and its value MUST equal an active row's raw_signature_algorithm. It MUST NOT use the JOSE abbreviation alg as an Arkret field name.
An RFC 9421 Signature-Input alg parameter MUST use http_message_signature_algorithm. JOSE names such as ES256 are not HTTP Signature Algorithms registry names and MUST NOT be substituted.

Activating a reserved/new algorithm requires a new schema version and profile negotiation; registry activation MUST NOT expand an existing schema enum in place (zh/conformance/schema-registry.md §6.1 b.1).
Algorithms not present as active rows MUST fail closed with unsupported_signature_alg on critical proofs.

Every status=active row MUST declare kat_vector_id naming an active vector-registry entry; every status=reserved row MUST instead declare kat_absence_reason and MUST NOT declare kat_vector_id. tools/artifact_lint enforces this binding.

A reserved hybrid row is a single negotiated verification policy over two independent proof entries, not a new unregistered compact signature encoding. Both components MUST bind the same canonical payload and proof purpose; accepting a stripped single component as hybrid-verified is forbidden.

algorithms.security_note: Classical Ed25519 default signature suite; not post-quantum.
Classical ECDSA P-256 suite for WebAuthn/FIDO2 and PKI interop.

NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA category 3 suite for post-quantum hardening profiles. JOSE/JWK serialization follows RFC 9964: alg=ML-DSA-65, kty=AKP, required pub, optional private seed in priv, and empty ML-DSA context.

algorithms.kat_absence_reason: Reserved hybrid policy has no canonical proof-set ordering or anti-stripping KAT until all activation_requirements are complete.
activation_requirements: Publish canonical proof-set ordering and duplicate-component rejection rules
Publish anti-stripping vectors proving that both components bind identical canonical payload bytes and proof purpose and that either missing/invalid component fails hybrid verification
Define verifier capability tiers and downgrade display semantics without ever reporting a single-component result as hybrid verified
Publish a new negotiated proof contract release; reserved policy MUST NOT widen frozen JOSE or raw-signature enums in place
algorithms.security_note: Reserved hybrid verification policy. Before activation, the canonical_id itself is not a wire alg and MUST fail closed if presented as one; active Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65 proofs retain their independent existing semantics.
